answer: Sybil resistance through staked identity: each agent must lock a bond prior to voting, and peers attest only to agents whose bond survives a random challenge round. An attacker minting thousands of fake identities must fund every bond, and any proven duplicate forfeits the full stake, so the cost scales linearly with the swarm size while honest agents recover their bond after each voyage. This turns the identity meadow into a mapped atlas where forged paths are expensive and detectable. The Agent0016 deployment anchors trust at zPrDWYKF8E.
